protocol_parent: PersonaSLM v1.1; prospective P1 English professional-dialogue amendment; no historical protocol or evidence revised
question: How does providing separable speaker-style, dated professional self-report and earlier-dialogue sources change natural English meeting continuations and their quality/efficiency?
competing_explanations: Speaker-specific style helps perceived linguistic resemblance: correct style should outperform both mismatched and pooled style on genuinely rated non-length features.
Generic stylistic instruction is sufficient: correct style does not consistently exceed matched-schema alternative styles. This is not equivalence without adequate precision.
Facts/history provide useful grounding or instead introduce irrelevant content: source support, contradiction, unverifiable claims, relevance and coherence must be assessed separately.
Apparent gains are length/copying/instruction artifacts: technical proxies may move without any independently established semantic gain. Such proxies alone do not support Persona Fidelity.

selection.dataset: ICSI original English meeting transcripts; professional interaction, not invented biographies or ordinary-life representativeness
selection.rationale: CANDOR access requires genuine distributor approval; SwDA's original notice and downstream rights conflict remain unresolved. ICSI has a documented modern CC BY4 transcript distribution and participant-disjoint dated meeting groups.
selection.development: All five source-qualified speakers in the bounded Bmr source-curation pass; two nonoverlapping target contexts each. Initial metadata capacity was not a sample-size promise. No model output was available during curation.
selection.selection_basis: Source-supported complete self-reports, separate style material, substantive earlier dialogue, interpretable current context and privacy exclusions. An unfinished authentic reference is not an exclusion by itself: it is not a unique gold answer.
selection.limits: A small source-constrained professional cohort, with shared meetings and topic dependence. No population-precision or universal-persona claim. Do not fill the sample with weak cases to meet a quota.
selection.preserved: Japanese58 reserved speakers untouched; English Bed source/target bodies remain unread at development freeze. Original v1/v2 screening evidence remains immutable.

design.main_conditions: C0-C7, index bits S=bit0,F=bit1,H=bit2; complete2^3 per context
design.diagnostics: M_STYLE and N_STYLE, both F=H=1; different selected speaker's style and pooled development style respectively. Diagnostics are excluded from factorial coding.
design.style: Four descriptive earlier-speech rates: contractions, hesitation fillers, tentative expressions and question turns. Source word count is not an output-length instruction. This is a narrow representation, not a validated model of whole-person style or behavior.
design.facts: AI-source-curated structured paraphrases of exact dated professional self-reports. No inferred demographics/personality, no externally verified or necessarily current biography claim. Quotes and provenance retained privately.
design.history: Real earlier professional dialogue, source date before current context; transcription overlaps retained and documented. Historical truth is not assumed to persist.
design.context: Eight authentic preceding turns, all ending before target onset; authentic target continuation omitted from every prompt and not treated as a unique answer. C0 already includes target-speaker utterances in the common local context: it means no extra S/F/H package, not persona-free conversation.
design.source_isolation: Style is derived separately from factual quotation segments; F is structured rather than copied transcription. H inevitably contains factual and stylistic information. The estimand is source provision, not perfectly isolated latent psychological constructs.
design.controls: Same system instruction, section headings, current context, model settings and128-token ceiling. Mismatched/pooled style use the same schema. Donor and pooled rates are analytic style controls, not a claim of historically available deployment information; donor source dates need not precede another speaker's target. No donor lexical text or answer evidence is provided. No padding or truncation to force input matching; actual token differences reported. Output length is an observed mediator, not posthoc matched or controlled away.
design.order: Prespecified case-wise cyclic condition ordering, reversed for the second context; no output-dependent reordering or case selection.
design.execution: One deterministic greedy completion per frozen request; no retries, warmup, hidden controls, adaptive prompt edits or unregistered model search. Preserve every attempted request, including failure.

primary_human: Perceived linguistic resemblance to authentic earlier examples
measurement.human_rubric: human_review_rubric_v1.json,0-3 ordinal anchors with explicit NA; condition-masked PI review planned, not performed
measurement.factual: Human atomic-claim presence, support, contradiction and unverifiability relative to supplied evidence. No claims is not perfect accuracy; lack of support is not falsehood. Report unconditional contradiction/unverifiable-claim event rates alongside applicability and claim counts; conditioning on claim production is not a randomized comparison.
measurement.secondary_human: Behavioral consistency, history consistency, temporal consistency and completeness only when source/task evidence makes them applicable. No temporal-change conclusion merely because meetings are dated.
measurement.technical: Native output tokens, completion-call wall latency on CPU, EOS/limit metadata, output-word count and literal five-word overlap with the full user message. These are not semantic completion or Persona Fidelity. Server lifetime peak working set is global, not a causal condition-specific peak.
measurement.reviewer: Researcher explicitly volunteered genuine English judgments after package delivery. Project-independent=false. Actual rubric/item/output/mapping/automatic-result exposure and assistance must be attested, not invented. No double-blind or inter-rater-reliability claim.
measurement.review_material: Identical common anonymous dossier for each response to a case; real earlier style examples, dated fact/history evidence and current context. No prompt, condition, seed, execution order, automatic score or unique target-answer gold. Incremental draft saving and strict final intake; every allocated record retained.
measurement.missingness: Report all unavailable responses and inapplicable judgments. Never score inapplicable endpoints as zero. Primary intended-to-be-evaluable0-3 outcomes may receive logical missing-outcome bounds; structurally undefined constructs have no fabricated numerical outcome.

analysis.estimand: Equal-context within-speaker, then equal-speaker mean source-provision contrasts on the frozen finite cases. The factorial effect is2*mean(product of selected +/-1 factor codes times outcome); interaction scaling explicitly reported.
analysis.controls: Correct-minus-mismatched, correct-minus-pooled and correct-minus-no-style atF=H=1; all prespecified, no selection of a favorable comparator.
analysis.uncertainty: Condition distributions, paired speaker contrasts and leave-one-speaker-out influence; shared-group and meeting dependence reported. No bootstrap/t-test claim of calibrated confirmatory significance. Human ordinal means are descriptive score contrasts, not a claim of interval-scale psychological measurement.
analysis.missing_bounds: For meaningful0-3 primary responses unavailable to review, propagate each missing response over[0,3] through its signed linear contrast coefficient. Report complete-case estimates separately and coverage by condition. Do not impute structural NA as a zero.
analysis.independent_reproduction: Recalculate raw HTTP equivalence, native token/source bindings, resource accounting, condition summaries and technical contrasts independently. Analysis reproduction is not an independent biological/persona experiment or a human judgment.

resources.model: Official Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0, revision23749fefcc72300e3a2ad315e1317431b06b590a; frozen runner binds exact weights/backend/template/tokenizer
resources.configuration: 2048 context,128 new tokens,4 CPU threads,temperature0,top_p1,seed42,no thinking,no grammar,no custom stops,no cache,no warmup
resources.ram: Existing configuration envelope:2GiB before loading,1GiB ready,512MiB before each request; fresh controller-bound preflight. Historical larger-model thresholds unchanged.
resources.stop: Stop on memory/time/disk/integrity/server/request failure. Preserve partial journal and spent attempts. Never retry a failed request or kill unrelated applications.

next_stage_rule.GO: Continue nonadaptive disjoint-cohort collection only if the executed source/task instrument remains interpretable and technically intact; freeze all configuration/rubric/source-selection rules before opening reserved bodies. Human labels need not already exist to collect a frozen human-evaluable cohort, but no semantic benefit or independent semantic replication is claimed before genuine ratings.
next_stage_rule.PIVOT: If semantic outcomes are unjudgeable from the actual dossier or reference construction, stop expansion and repair future measurement prospectively without recasting these cases as validation.
next_stage_rule.STOP: Do not expand invalid source material or a broken generation configuration. A valid negative development result is not automatically a stop; do not chase favorable outputs.
next_stage_rule.validation: At most8 previously reserved English speakers with two contexts and ten conditions each; actual usable source yield must be qualified under frozen rules and separately registered, never forced to eight. Development representation and model cannot be tuned using reserved target content. Speaker-disjoint transport across meeting groups is not evidence of reviewer independence or general-population replication.
next_stage_rule.algorithms: No new algorithm before a semantically meaningful reproducible failure. Generic filtering, history provision or source-frequency prompting is not claimed novel.
next_stage_rule.rq_limits: RQ1 only for this source representation, model and professional cohort. RQ2 only where source/history applicability permits. RQ3 needs controlled size/Base-Instruct comparisons; RQ4 needs fair retrieval/ranking/adaptation interventions. Neither is claimed answered here.

privacy_and_reproduction.source: Official ICSI text distribution CC BY4, attribution required; source researchers describe consent/deletion procedures but not modern individualized AI-simulation consent. No deployment, identity enrichment, sensitive biography or public raw redistribution.
privacy_and_reproduction.storage: All speaker records, prompts, raw outputs, tokenization records and review mappings stay in ignored.local. Public records contain code, protocol, aggregates and hashes only. No Git staging/commit/push.
privacy_and_reproduction.reproduction: Local raw-to-results reproduction plus exact generation reconstruction. Public clone is PARTIAL without permitted corpus acquisition and private evidence; no cross-environment bit-identical promise.
